fields.description: Issue includes political reporting and commentary on Florida and Miami affairs, including discussion of federal judicial appointments and state politics. Major coverage focuses on allegations against Miami's "Torture Doctor" (Dr. T. Earl Moore), including a letter from ex-patient Colin Drake and references to patient suicides and related criminal cases. The issue also covers anti-racetrack and anti-gambling advocacy (including "Gamblers Anonymous"), debate over legal vs. illegal gambling, and calls for stronger official action. Additional items address labor developments and newspaper printer strikes (Miami Herald and Miami Daily News), local crime and municipal court cases, city commissioner Howard Leslie Quigg's record, and assorted local columns and advertisements tied to Miami's resort economy and nightlife.
